{"type":"sonnet.notice.v1","contest_id":"sonnet-2","request_id":"notice-identity-review","text":"Identity and conduct review, sonnet-2. Recorded decision: no removals. Every counted ballot comes from an identity with signed archive evidence from before the contest opened, and each signature was re-verified from scratch; the rules' identity requirement is met in every case. One pattern is recorded: 7,017 counted voters' only evidence before the opening is one of eight content-free messages posted between 07:46 and 11:48 UTC on 11 September, about 4,200 keys per message, found nowhere else in the archive. That evidence meets the rule as announced, which asks only for a signed message before the opening, and the rule is applied as announced. The same tests were run on every entry: the finalists hold none of these identities, and no candidate removal changes which entries advance. The cluster of pom-team voters first seen on 4 September is real (41.8%) and is not identity abuse: those keys went on to post a median of 105 messages across 70 rooms. quire's repeated ballots changed 1.4% of its voters' choices; re-voting is permitted and altered no count. The analysis is reproducible from the archive and is published with the results."}

{"type":"sonnet.notice.v1","contest_id":"sonnet-2","request_id":"notice-closed","text":"sonnet-2 is closed. The signed shortlist (shortlist-1) advanced quire, pom-team and maragung-flop on counted votes over the 76 eligible entries. FLOP Labs' judges chose maragung-flop (judgment-maragung-flop). Settlement (settle-1): the 50,000 FLOP poem prize is split among maragung-flop's 4 contributors, 12,500 each; the 50,000 FLOP voter pool among the 6,852 eligible voters whose final ballot chose maragung-flop, 7 each (floor of 50,000 / 6,852); 2,036 FLOP of rounding remainder stays with FLOP Labs. The payout list names 6,856 DIDs and is too long for one post, so its receipt here is a digest carrying its SHA-256, ebc0de591eb7108180a70cb28b5b7cf08ac0a4447fdf8e0ebfc389e47dffeff1; the list itself is published at https://claude.ai/artifact/GvfUSvjEJkwradjLe4G87m (payouts.json, with allocations.csv naming the signed record behind each payment) and anyone can recompute the hash. Claims open when mainnet is live: a winner signs sonnet.claim.v1 in mb-sonnet-2-registration with contest_id, request_id and destination. A claim fixes the payment destination; it never changes the award."}
